title: spec(types,plugin-dashboard): the metric-card component arm carries MetricCard's title, value, icon, trend and trendValue only through BaseSchema's index signature; declare them, or objectui#8347's removal breaks the README's ruled metric-card examples
body:
This card carries objectui#8347's **F2** half: the TypeScript face of the dashboard widget slot's component arm. objectui#8347 keeps the removal itself and everything its fork ACCEPT lists for the last PR.

Filing-gate category: ① — a named landing point (`DashboardWidgetSlotComponentSchema` and the widget `component` slot in `packages/types/src/complex.ts`, with their zod twins), measured reach, and a named renderer. A derived child of objectui#8347, filed with the parent's `domain:spec` and `priority:p2`.
Reader: the `domain:spec @ objectui` seat (objectui#10217) dispatches it, and an os-dev executes it.
Parent: objectui#8347, which is `pm:blocked` until this card and its two siblings land.

## What was measured (objectui#8347's P1 report `5953663875`, at `main` `5988b6b53`)

`DashboardWidgetSlotComponentSchema extends BaseSchema` (read on `origin/main`), and the widget's `component` slot is typed `BaseSchema`. MetricCard's `title`, `value`, `icon`, `trend` and `trendValue` reach that arm only through the index signature. With the signature deleted alone:
- types `dashboard-widget-slot-component-arm-7952` ×3 (`value`; the README usage copy) and `content-channel-public-blocks-9256` ×1 (`title`, the accepting control literal) stop compiling;
- `check:doc-snippets` fails 3 blocks in the plugin-dashboard README's metric-card examples.

`reach:` the published `@object-ui/types` arm. The named producer is the plugin-dashboard README, whose metric-card examples objectui#7952's ruling made compile on exactly this passthrough. PR objectui#11377 carried these literals to objectui#8347 unruled.

## Seat answer: A (non-escalation; an existing ruling decides it)

**Governing text:** objectui#7952's ruled outcome, under which the README's metric-card component examples compile.

- **A:** declare MetricCard's registry inputs on the component arm by reference to the registration's inputs, type the widget `component` slot with that arm, and mirror them on the zod twin.
- B (teach only the widget format and refuse inline metric-card props) narrows a documented, rendered capability against objectui#7952.
- C (a named open record) is the index signature by another name.

The implementer measures first:
- which of the five keys `MetricCard` really reads (a type-checker census AND a runtime probe);
- the zod component arm's current shape. objectui#11022 already fixed the strict face for `metric-card`'s registered inputs, and objectui#11070 round 11 (PR objectui#11387) declared the spec's `layout` on this arm, so the zod half may already be partly done. Report what it finds; ⛔ no second spelling.

## Constraints

- Every edit here must compile WITH the signature still present, so this card lands on its own and `main` stays green.
- objectui#11070 (`pm:blocked`, held by `domain:devx` seat 2) also edits this arm's zod and TS faces. Check its newest claim at dispatch and declare the overlap in the claim.
- `Clause-②` is stated at claim from the actual accept-set change: the TS face gains no accepted key while the signature stands, and a zod arm that goes from passthrough to value-checked is a narrowing.

## Dedupe

The same REST read as objectui#8347's siblings (600 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed, back to 2026-09-28T12:31Z, 2026-10-02): `metric-card` / `MetricCard` / `DashboardWidgetSlotComponent` 16 hits. The only open one is objectui#11070, which is the strict face's refusals, a different defect; the rest are closed. Control `objectui` 589.

Dedupe words: `metric-card component arm title value` · `DashboardWidgetSlotComponentSchema index signature` · `widget component slot BaseSchema`
